text:
Your biggest enemy isn't laziness. It's indecision.

It's 11 p.m. You're watching a video about starting a business. Yesterday it was fitness. Last week it was coding. You've 'researched' 9 different paths and walked zero of them.

That's the research loop. And it feels productive. THAT'S THE TRAP.

Pick one thing. Give it 90 days. No switching. No backup plans.

Decisiveness isn't knowing the right choice. It's making a choice and making it right.
caption:
Indecision is the silent killer of self improvement. Most men spend years 'keeping options open' instead of building the discipline to commit. That's a mindset problem, not a talent problem.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#selfimprovement #discipline #mindset #mentalstrength #becomebetter
